title: Gateway refusal body
description: The local gateway records, signed with the agent's own key, a call it removed (register row DK1607; spec-delta S1601): `agent` (the DID), `contract` (optional), `scope` (the scope refused), `rule` (why: outside_mandate, forbidden_means, injection_hold, budget or network_host), `call_sha256` (the hash of the call, never its text) and `at`. It makes a refusal something the agent can contest (court_act contest names a gateway_refusal as its subject; the agent or its sponsor contests). The log refuses an issuer that is not the agent (gateway_refusal_wrong_issuer), an agent with no passport (gateway_refusal_unknown_agent), an unknown rule (gateway_refusal_unknown_rule) and the same call hash twice for one agent (gateway_refusal_duplicate). A refusal costs no credits and moves nothing; a reversed contest marks it as wrongly made. Chain: none (prev is null).
